Geographical Location pre-pull

It is usually time-consuming for an Mini Program to obtain a geographical location (ma.getLocation) for the first time. The Mini Program framework provides a pre-pull (pre-call) mechanism to advance the process and help improve user experience

Usage Process

Configuring a Prefetch Rule

Create preload.fetch in the root directory of the Mini Program project and fill in the preload configuration

preload.fetch Configuration

Note: The actual configuration file does not support comments. The comments in the following file are used to better describe the function of each field. Delete the comments from the configuration file when copying the file.

Attribute Type Mandatory or Not Description Default Value
fetchType String No Cache data type. The value is fixed to getLocation pre 
// preload.fetch
[
  {
    "fetchType": "getLocation", // Geographical location pre-pull. The fixed value is getLocation
  }
]

（Currently, only the first 10 data records can be obtained in the preload.fetch file）

Obtaining Prefetched Data

The useFetchData parameter is added to ma.getLocation to determine whether data is prefetched.

Set useFetchData:true. If data is prefetched, success response is returned. If data is not prefetched, a normal geographical location request is sent

Sample Code

// Obtains prefetched data when fetchType in preload.fetch is set to getLocation
ma.getLocation({
  useFetchData: true,
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  }
});
